exposure: timing of fetal movements during pregnancy
intensity of fetal movements during pregnancy
frequency of fetal movements during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 4038 women with a history of childbirth.
finding: Phantom fetal movements (PFMs) were reported by 40.5% of participants, occurring mainly during the 6 months after childbirth, and were significantly associated with younger maternal age, number of pregnancies, caesarean delivery, and postpartum complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with the occurrence of phantom fetal movements.
